findings.summary: D0 (line 53) is a tagged union of two regularity settings presented as one class identity: r = smooth (Frechet smooth-with-decay constraint manifold) or r = (sobolev,s,delta) (weighted-Sobolev Banach product). The two branches do not share an ambient topology (line 159 vs 160), genericity.is_part_of_class is true (line 164), and tier_1 (lines 251-258) refutes the whole class from one r, leaving the other branch untouched. The frozen supplement calls the Sobolev branch a 'registered Sobolev variant' (artifacts/formulation/formulation_taxonomy.yaml:109, d7419b4e), but no such registration resolves: VARIANT_REGISTRY v2.0 (5eb42f9a) registers 7 variants for the four frozen parents (SET, CH, DISTRIBUTIONAL, H2LOC, TWOSIDED, L2CONN, LIP) with no Sobolev/data-class entry; the declared F0 taxonomy's variants list has 2 (SET, CH); artifacts/formulation/variants/ contains only AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN.variant-CH.delta.json and AF-WCC-VAC-GEN.variant-SET.delta.json; the supplement axis_registry has no data-class axis. So the class identity is not decidable from the artifact as pinned: either the branch must be registered as a variant (parent + variant_id) or the tagged union must be adjudicated as a parameter of one statement by lead-audit. This is the rev12 form of the finding worker-034/07 raised at 1bb78ce9; the repair changed the form (single binder r, well-typed) but did not register the branch; the F2a reviewer of 034-repin explicitly deferred the 'tagged union vs single-data-class criterion' to lead-audit.
findings.effect_if_fixed: Register the Sobolev/data-class branch in VARIANT_REGISTRY (parent AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN, e.g. variant SOBOLEV) with its ambient topology and strength relation, or record a lead-audit ruling that a tagged regularity parameter is one statement; then the class-identity check can pass.

genericity.ambient_space justifies Baire-ness by 'X_vac is a closed subset of a Banach space, hence Baire', which covers the weighted-Sobolev branch; topology_or_measure declares a Frechet topology for the smooth branch. Frechet spaces are Baire, so the non-emptiness conclusion survives, but the stated reason does not cover the branch where it is needed. Same finding as my earlier N-17-03 at the previous pin; still open.

data_class.asymptotic_decay uses the Sobolev exponent s as the derivative bound inside the smooth default ('|d^k h| = O(r^{-1-k}) for 1 <= k <= s', '0 <= k <= s-1'). The rev12 F-2 well-typedness repair fixed the D0 binder but this slot still mixes the two D0 branches' vocabulary; a reader cannot tell whether the smooth branch requires the rate for all k or only up to the Sobolev s.
